evidence: Adds wallet_taproot_decaying_multisig_descriptor_psbt.py to test wallet PSBT workflows and descriptor management.
rationale: Adds functional test coverage for wallet PSBT workflows combining MuSig2 aggregate key paths with timelocked Miniscript script paths across watch-only and single-key signer wallets. While Bitcoin Core already supported these primitives, this provides useful end-to-end integration verification against regressions in complex multi-party descriptor workflows.
